info.name: Freely Mock API
info.description:
Mock backend for the Freely Android app, read by `NetworkFreelyRepository`. Every response was generated from `MockFreelyData.kt`, the app's built-in offline copy of this data; `FreelyApiContractTest` checks they match.

**Set up:** create a mock server from this collection, then paste its URL into the `baseUrl` collection variable.

**Contract (the app parses with Gson):**
- JSON keys are the Kotlin property names (camelCase). Enums are their constant names (`Online`, `Read`, `VoiceNote`, ...).
- Every non-null field is always present. Gson bypasses Kotlin constructors, so a missing field arrives as null even when the Kotlin type is non-null.
- Chat messages carry a `type` of `Text`, `VoiceMemo` or `Place` that selects the `ChatMessage` subclass.
- Image URLs are Stitch-hosted; the app appends `=s<px>` to load resized copies. The current user's photo is from Unsplash and carries its own size parameters.

Force a specific example with the `x-mock-response-name` header (e.g. `family`) or `x-mock-response-code: 404`.

request.description:
Chat Thread screen. `FreelyRepository.getChatThread(conversationId)` -> `ChatThread`.

The id is an inbox conversation id (`maya`, `weekend-hikers`, `david`, `chloe`, `family`) or a contact's person id. Maya's thread is the full designed conversation, other inbox chats return their last message, and people without a chat yet return an empty thread. Unknown ids return 404.
